operating_notes.text: Standalone related-party purchases of non-principal-protected structured products from other related parties were ₹6,812.63 Cr in FY26 versus ₹5,331.43 Cr in FY25.
Brand charges paid to related parties were ₹5.53 Cr in FY26 (FY25: ₹4.51 Cr).
Anand Rathi Wealth UK Limited, a foreign subsidiary, reported a loss of ₹1.29 Cr in FY26.
FY26 AUM was ₹93,037 Cr against guidance of ₹1,00,000 Cr, while revenue and PAT both exceeded guidance.
Private wealth AUM per relationship manager rose to ₹226 Cr at Mar-26 from ₹198 Cr at Mar-25, with 401 RMs and 33 clients per RM.
OFA platform assets were ₹6,906 Cr at Mar-26 across 1,47,192 MFDs/IFAs and 24 lakh platform clients.
Authorised share capital raised to ₹100 Cr (20,00,00,000 equity shares of ₹5 each) from ₹50 Cr, following AGM approval.
AUM mix included about ₹55,000 Cr in equity and ₹4,500 Cr in debt, plus structured products.
Primary MLD issuance was ₹2,187 Cr in Q1FY27 (₹1,875 Cr to group companies, ₹312 Cr third party) versus ₹1,704 Cr a year ago; secondary was ₹968 Cr versus ₹755 Cr.
Digital wealth AUM rose 23% YoY to ₹2,526 Cr with 7,320 clients; OFA SaaS had 6,890 subscribers and ₹1.66 lakh Cr platform assets.
Achieved highest ever quarterly equity mutual fund net flow of ₹2,867 crores in Q2 FY27.

timeline.summary: Anand Rathi Wealth Limited’s officials will hold a Group of Individual Investors webinar on April 29, 2026, per SEBI’s Regulation 30(6).

Anand Rathi Wealth filed its FY26 annual report on 27 April 2026 with a clean unmodified audit, ₹1,149 Cr consolidated revenue and ₹87.21 Cr of standalone related-party transactions, ahead of its 31st AGM on 21 May 2026.
Anand Rathi Wealth held its 31st AGM on 21 May 2026, reporting FY26 revenue of ₹1,198 Cr and PAT of ₹386 Cr, guiding FY27 to ₹1,415 Cr revenue and ₹460 Cr PAT, and approving a 1:1 bonus issue.
Anand Rathi Wealth Limited’s 31st AGM on May 21, 2026, approved standalone/consolidated financials for FY2026 with 99.95% assent (52,960,485 votes) and 0.05% dissent (26,566 votes).

Anand Rathi Wealth's 31st AGM on 21 May 2026 passed resolutions doubling authorised share capital from ₹50 Cr to ₹100 Cr by creating 10,00,00,000 new equity shares of ₹5 each, amending Clause V of the MoA.
Anand Rathi Wealth's Bonus Allotment Committee on 4 June 2026 allotted 8,30,20,634 bonus shares in a 1:1 ratio, doubling paid-up capital to ₹83.02 Cr.

On 10 July 2026 Anand Rathi Wealth's Q1FY27 call reported revenue up 18% to ₹336 Cr and PAT up 24% to ₹116 Cr ex-fair-value, with AUM up 21% to ₹1,06,300 Cr and FY27 guidance of ₹1,415 Cr revenue and ₹460 Cr PAT retained.
Anand Rathi Wealth Limited’s officials will hold a virtual Group of Individual Investors meeting on 22nd October 2026, discussing publicly available information.
Anand Rathi Wealth reported Q2 FY27 consolidated net profit of ₹122 crores, up 22% YoY, alongside record net inflows.
